verdict.rationale: No first-party evidence documents bank-hosted OAuth connections, an OAuth coverage list, or a plan to retire legacy credential flows. The Link docs only describe a generic client-side linking component. Community reports describe screen-scraping (plaid-comm-4) and PSD2 open-banking use in Europe (plaid-comm-14), but these are not the product's own documentation of the capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, connections to major institutions use bank-hosted OAuth rather than screen-scraped credentials — the platform documents its OAuth coverage and how legacy credential flows are being retired
